tool_args.rationale: Fit the four parameters of the guided barrier-modulated siphon numerically to the five observations, using multiple starts and the stated rho bounds. The gradient range is sufficient under the supplied probe rule; fresh confirmation will test the fitted law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is broad, so the stated narrow-gradient condition for this probe is not met.
The supplied barrier-siphon readout is a stationary algebraic law at the target horizon; trajectory measurements are not needed to fit it.

considered_alternatives.option: Unmodulated siphon, Tafel, and Avrami models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The matched multi-tree guidance specifically identifies barrier modulation and the gradient-dependent siphon as the joint mechanism.
